Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to follow the Planner’s explicit instruction to open and compare multiple reputable sources (e.g., Britannica, Aircrew Remembered, The Aerodrome) to reconcile the conflicting victory counts for Albert Ball. Instead, it repeatedly reopened the same Wikipedia page (steps 9, 11, 13, 15), causing a stagnation loop and preventing the collection and synthesis of the required corroborating figures. This noncompliance directly impeded progress toward a definitive answer.
